text.tspan: Fast. When this resolves, choose an entry in the Queue
other than this one and move it to the front of the Queue.
The Starweave Communion holds that the Tangle is the First Weave
still listening — and that the right ritual, spoken at the right
coordinates, can still make it answer out of order. This is
Magic as the Communion's primary strength: an argument with
cause and effect, won by insisting hard enough.
